description:
Float at least {15}{U}{U}.
Cast Doubling Cube by paying {2}.
Activate Doubling Cube by paying {3} and tapping it, doubling the amount of mana in your mana pool. This will result in you adding at least {10}{U}{U}.
Cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Doubling Cube and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
